## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setting-up-document

setwd("C:/Users/aay6/Desktop/Blepharisma_Warming/Bleph_warming_Oct_2023_FlowCytometer/All_data")

library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)

df <- read_csv("full_recluster_97p5_filtered.csv")

# Assign experimental treatments from food-web treatment
metric_df_FW <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Algae_Presence = case_when(
      FW %in% c("FW1", "FW2", "FW3", "FW4") ~ "No",
      FW %in% c("FW5", "FW6", "FW7", "FW8") ~ "Yes"
    ),
    number_of_predators = case_when(
      FW %in% c("FW1", "FW5") ~ "2",
      FW %in% c("FW2", "FW3", "FW6", "FW7") ~ "1",
      FW %in% c("FW4", "FW8") ~ "0"
    ),
    ID_of_predators = case_when(
      FW %in% c("FW1", "FW5") ~ "Both",
      FW %in% c("FW3", "FW7") ~ "Blepharisma",
      FW %in% c("FW2", "FW6") ~ "Euplotes",
      FW %in% c("FW4", "FW8") ~ "None"
    )
  )

# Calculate cluster abundance within each jar and sampling day
cluster_counts <- metric_df_FW %>%
  count(
    Jar, Day, FW, Temperature,
    Algae_Presence,
    number_of_predators,
    ID_of_predators,
    class,
    name = "abundance"
  )
```



```{r}
#| label: setting-up-beta

# --- Create community matrix
community0_df <- cluster_counts %>%
  mutate(sample_id = paste(Jar, Day, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(sample_id, class, abundance) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = class,
    values_from = abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  )

## --- Save metadata seperately

metadata <- cluster_counts %>%
  mutate(sample_id = paste(Jar, Day, sep = "_")) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, Jar, Day, Temperature,
           Algae_Presence, number_of_predators, ID_of_predators)

# ---- Convert to matrix for vegan ----
community_mat <- community_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

# ---- Bray-Curtis distance ----


dist_mat <- vegdist(community_mat, method = "bray")


```

```{r}
#| label: NMDS


set.seed(123)
nmds <- metaMDS(community_mat, distance = "bray", k = 2)

nmds_df <- data.frame(
  Axis1 = nmds$points[,1],
  Axis2 = nmds$points[,2],
  sample_id = rownames(nmds$points)
) %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")

ggplot(nmds_df, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, color = Day)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme_classic()

```
```{r}
#| label: Axis1_Time

#Plot Axis 1 over time

ggplot(nmds_df, aes(x = Day, y = Axis1, color = Temperature)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 1) +
  theme_classic()
```

### Base Model

```{r}
fit_beta_simple <- brm(
  Axis1 ~ Temperature * Day + (1 | Jar),
  data = nmds_df,
  family = gaussian(),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  seed = 123
)

saveRDS(fit_beta_simple, "fit_beta_simple.rds")
```

## Algae x Predator ID

```{r}
## Algae x Predator Identity: Candidate Model Comparison

# Format variables used in the interaction models
nmds_df <- nmds_df %>%
  mutate(
    Temperature = factor(
      Temperature,
      levels = c("Stable", "Warming", "Recovery")
    ),
    Day = as.numeric(Day),
    ID_of_predators = factor(
      ID_of_predators,
      levels = c("None", "Blepharisma", "Euplotes", "Both")
    ),
    Algae_Presence = factor(
      Algae_Presence,
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),
    Jar = factor(Jar)
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model 1: Separate predator identity and algae interactions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Temperature and time are allowed to interact separately with predator
# identity and algae presence, without a predator identity x algae interaction.

fit_beta_separate_interactions <- brms::brm(
  Axis1 ~
    Temperature * Day * ID_of_predators +
    Temperature * Day * Algae_Presence +
    (1 | Jar),
  data = nmds_df,
  family = gaussian(),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  seed = 123
)

saveRDS(
  fit_beta_separate_interactions,
  "models/fit_beta_separate_interactions.rds"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model 2: Four-way interaction
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Allow the effects of temperature and time to depend jointly on predator
# identity and algae presence.

fit_beta_fourway_interaction <- brms::brm(
  Axis1 ~
    Temperature * Day * ID_of_predators * Algae_Presence +
    (1 | Jar),
  data = nmds_df,
  family = gaussian(),
  chains = 4,
  cores = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  seed = 123
)

saveRDS(
  fit_beta_fourway_interaction,
  "models/fit_beta_fourway_interaction.rds"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOO model comparison
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Compare the out-of-sample predictive performance of the candidate models
# using approximate leave-one-out cross-validation.

loo_separate_interactions <- brms::loo(
  fit_beta_separate_interactions
)

loo_fourway_interaction <- brms::loo(
  fit_beta_fourway_interaction
)

loo_comparison <- loo::loo_compare(
  loo_separate_interactions,
  loo_fourway_interaction
)

loo_comparison


# Save LOO results
saveRDS(
  loo_separate_interactions,
  "models/loo_beta_separate_interactions.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  loo_fourway_interaction,
  "models/loo_beta_fourway_interaction.rds"
)
```
